blocks.text: Darja hararat barhne se reaction ki rate barhti hai: har 10 degrees C izafe par rate dugni ya tigni ho jati hai. Darja hararat ka aam taur par bara asar hota hai, kyunke zyada darja hararat par molecules ke paas zyada hararati energy hoti hai aur woh zyada baar aur zyada energy se takrate hain. Boltzmann distribution curve kisi darja hararat par molecular energies ki taqseem dikhata hai: chand zarraat ki energy bohat kam, chand ki bohat zyada, aur bohat se darmiyani energy rakhte hain. Curve ke neeche ka raqba zarraat ki tadaad zahir karta hai, aur activation energy Ea se aage shaded raqba un molecules ka tanasub jin ke paas takrane par kimiyai tabdeeli lane ki kaafi energy hai.

Jaise reaction mixture ka darja hararat barhaya jaye, zarraat ki ausat kinetic energy barhti hai; woh tez chalte hain, zyada baar takrate hain, aur kamyab collisions ka tanasub bohat barhta hai. Zyada darja hararat par Boltzmann curve chapta hota hai aur us ki choti daen khiskti hai, aur 10 degrees C izafe par Ea se aage shaded raqba taqreeban dugna ho jata hai. Nateeja: darja hararat barhane se reaction ki rate barhti hai.

blocks.alt: Baen: energy ke muqable molecules ki tadaad ke do ubhre curves, kam darja hararat ke liye ooncha neela aur zyada ke liye daen khiska chapta surkh, Ea par nuqtedar amoodi lakeer aur us se aage ke raqbe shaded. Daen: energy ka rasta jis mein uncatalysed reaction ke liye ooncha surkh ubhar aur catalysed ke liye neecha sabz ubhar, dono ek hi reactant satah se ek hi product satah tak.
blocks.caption: Do darja hararat par Boltzmann distribution aur catalysed aur uncatalysed reaction ka energy rasta (Figures 7.6 se 7.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka; curves schematic).
blocks.long_description: Har curve ke neeche ka raqba molecules ki kul tadaad hai aur Ea se aage shaded dum react kar sakne wala hissa. Zyada darja hararat par choti daen jati hai aur curve chapta hota hai, to 10 degree izafe par dum taqreeban dugni ho jati hai, aur molecules zyada baar takrate bhi hain: rate tezi se barhti hai. Catalyst reactants, products ya delta H nahi badalta; yeh kam rukawat par naya rasta kholta hai, to pehle se maujood molecules ka bara hissa use paar kar sakta hai.

blocks.prompt: Boltzmann distribution curve kya hai, aur 10 degrees C ka izafa rate ko taqreeban dugna kyun karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh kisi darja hararat par molecules ki tadaad ka un ki energy ke muqable graph hai, zyada energies ki lambi dum wala ek ubhar; us ke neeche ka raqba molecules ki tadaad aur Ea se aage dum react kar sakne wali tadaad hai. 10 degree garam karne se curve daen khiskta aur chapta hota hai, jo Ea se aage raqba taqreeban dugna karta hai, to taqreeban dugne collisions moassar hote hain aur rate taqreeban dugni ho jati hai.

items: Har 10 degrees C izafe par rate taqreeban dugni ya tigni: molecules tez chalte hain, zyada baar aur zyada energy se takrate hain.

Boltzmann distribution: energy ke muqable molecules ki tadaad; Ea se aage raqba react karne wala hissa hai, aur choti daen khiskne aur curve chapta hone se 10 degree izafe par taqreeban dugna ho jata hai.
